name: Rita Young
title: The Athlete
ability:
[reaction] After you evade an enemy: Either deal 1 damage to that enemy, or move to a connecting location. (Limit once per round.)
[elder_sign] effect: +2. Until the end of the round, ignore the limit on the above [reaction] ability.
ability_cn:
[reaction]在你躲避一名敌人后：对该敌人造成1点伤害，或者移动到一个连接地点。(每轮限制1次。)
[elder_sign]效果：+2。忽略以上[reaction]能力的限制，直到本轮结束。
elder_sign: [elder_sign] effect: +2. Until the end of the round, ignore the limit on the above
flavor_text: "You got a bone to pick? Fine by me. I don't need your permission to leave you in the dust."
back_text: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Survivor cards ([survivor]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5, [[Trick]] cards level 0-3. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): "I'm done runnin'!," Hoods, 1 random basic weakness.
back_text_cn: 卡牌张数：30。 牌组构建选项：求生者([survivor])等级0-5，中立卡牌等级0-5，[[技巧]]卡等级0-3。 牌组构建需求(不计入卡牌张数)："我不会再逃了！"、兜帽人,、1张随机基础弱点。
